answer: Each agent must lock a 50 dollar refundable bond in a vault before it can take paid work, and the bond is forfeited if the same operator is caught running duplicate identities. A voyage of paid jobs starts with money at risk from the first job, and an attacker creating 1,000 fake agents must tie up 50,000 dollars that can be seized on detection. The bond also takes 30 days to unlock after the last job, so a hit-and-run farm cannot recycle the same funds quickly. It is like a plume of smoke giving away a hidden fire before it spreads.
